stage1.impression: A clean, evenly lit showroom render, not a photograph of a night room. Bright cream floor and wall scallops, flat CG shelving and repeated book spines, a painted-on red bloom smeared around the speaker and onto the floor, and a uniform grain overlay all say 'render'. The red speaker on its plinth is legible but competes with eight saturated globes and coloured pendants, so it reads as a lighting shop or a generic retail corner, not a specific place a design magazine would publish.

blocking_9: Frame lum_median in 22-50 (now 83.6) with the floor and wall washes falling off into real darkness between pools of light
No 2D bloom or red smear: the speaker's colour reaches the floor only as physically plausible transmitted light, with clean edges at 1:1
Speaker region clip_pct under 0.5 % (now 4.99 %) while staying the brightest saturated object
Real material response at 1:1: board-formed concrete with tie holes and pour lines, oak with grain and wear, steel with patina; no flat CG panels or repeated book spines
No uniform overlaid grain and no haze glare blowing out the top right corner
Signs of a specific, lived-in shop: price cards at every piece, a record out of its sleeve, a coat, a used glass, the EARF nameplate unobstructed
A composition that makes the Tropos speaker the hero at a glance rather than one coloured object among fourteen

defects.what: Floor is a bright cream plane (lum_median 189), reads as a showroom floor under daylight, not a night room
Red smear on the floor in front of the plinth, looks like a 2D blurred overlay rather than transmitted light
Soft red halo bleeding outside the speaker's silhouette and onto the bookcase edge; speaker highlights clip (4.99 %)
Oak plinth reads as a flat pink cardboard box, no grain, clipped top edge (1.11 %)
Hot, hard-edged scallops on the concrete wall (lum_median 111, p95 236); concrete reads pink and flat
EARF nameplate half hidden behind the clear pendant and blown to neutral white
Haze glare washes out the top right corner and the top shelves of the record wall
Record/book wall: repeated spine models, uniform sizes, flat planes, reads as a texture library
Shelving is flat CG panels with LED strips; shelves sparse, lower right shelf empty, no price cards despite the brief
Uniform film-grain overlay over every surface including the dark areas, plus a pink-magenta lift in the midtones
Foreground chair is a crushed black silhouette (crush_pct 29 %), no leather sheen
Counter end with brass rail is cut by the frame edge and reads as an unexplained fluted cylinder
Card mismatch: settings list Domes, Orbs, an altar and Mother EARF, but the frame shows Core lamps, Hemisphere pendants and no Mother EARF; the settings may not describe this frame

changes.problem: The whole frame is overexposed for a night interior.

evidence.measured: lum_median 83.6, lum_mean 102.9 against a target of 22-50

changes.expected: Frame median drops into the low 40s; practicals and the speaker stay bright, shadows go deep.

changes.problem: The floor is lit like a showroom by the speaker's spots, a bright cream plane that is the largest bright area in the frame.

change.setting: lamps: the altar 2 x spot (the spots on the Tropos), and the floor's polish
change.from: 170.0 W, cone 30.0 deg; floor polish as now
change.to: 70 W, cone 18 deg aimed at the speaker's face and top; floor roughness up (matte honed concrete, darker tone by about 30 %)

changes.expected: A tight pool on the speaker and plinth, the floor falling off to dark within half a metre of the plinth.

changes.problem: A blurred red glow is painted around the speaker and across the floor, the clearest 'render/composite' tell in the frame.

evidence.measured: soft red smear with no hard edge, r_median 221 vs g 181 on the floor, halo past the speaker's silhouette at 2x

change.setting: finish: any glow/bloom pass and the speaker's colour spill
change.from: on (red bloom around the Ember speaker)
change.to: off; let the area lamps on the speaker provide the only transmitted red

changes.expected: Crisp acrylic edges at 1:1; floor red only where light actually passes through the cabinet, low saturation.

changes.problem: The speaker's face clips, flattening the acrylic and the batts inside.

change.setting: lamps: on each Ember speaker 4 x area

changes.expected: The speaker stays the brightest saturated object, its edges and interior read, no clipping.

changes.problem: The pendant downlights throw hot, hard scallops on the concrete that make the wall the brightest surface and flatten its texture.

change.setting: lamps: the Domes' downlights (the pendants' downlights)
change.to: 4 x spot, 8 W, cone 18 deg, aimed down onto the table and shelves rather than grazing the wall

changes.expected: Concrete wall drops to a low-key grazing wash where formwork and tie holes read; pools on the table and shelf tops.

changes.problem: Concrete, oak plinth and shelving read as flat CG planes and the concrete is pink, not warm grey.

evidence.measured: r_median 130, g 107, b 90 on concrete; plinth 640-835/620-720 flat with clip 1.11 %

change.setting: materials' finish: concrete tone and sheen, oak stain; render.white_balance_tint
change.from: pinkish flat concrete, pale untextured oak; tint -2.0
change.to: warm mid-grey board-formed concrete with visible pour lines and staining, matte; plinth and shelves in dark oiled oak with visible grain; tint 0

changes.expected: Materials read at real scale under 2400-2700 K light; less magenta in the midtones.

changes.problem: Haze glare and an overlaid uniform grain wash out the top right and coat every surface.

evidence.measured: milky veil over the upper record wall at 2x; grain identical in highlights and shadows across the frame

change.to: 0.0012 per metre; grain overlay off (keep only render noise, denoised)

changes.expected: The record wall's top shelves hold detail; atmosphere shows only in the light cones.

changes.problem: The shop lacks the specifics the brief asks for and any sign of life, so it reads as a generic display.

evidence.measured: no price cards visible; lower right shelf empty; nameplate half hidden behind the clear pendant at 490-590/140-190

change.from: no price cards, empty lower right shelf, nameplate behind pendant
change.to: a small letterpress price card at every piece; records leaning and one out of its sleeve on the lower right shelf; a coat over the foreground chair; shift the camera 0.3 m left or raise the pendant line so the EARF nameplate is clear

changes.expected: A specific, lived-in shop corner; the nameplate reads; the eye goes nameplate to speaker.

out_of_scope.request: Reduce the number or saturation of the coloured Core lamps and pendants so the speaker is the only saturated colour
out_of_scope.why: They are EARF products in the owner's chosen tints and the card fixes their colour; only their light levels may change

out_of_scope.request: Replace the generic bookcase/record wall and flat shelving with a more specific design
out_of_scope.why: The record wall and shelving are part of the room's design as proposed and fixed by the card

out_of_scope.request: Make the plinth thicker or change its proportion to the speaker
out_of_scope.why: Part of the room's design; only its finish may change

out_of_scope.request: Reconcile the card's settings (Domes, Orbs, altar, Mother EARF) with what this frame shows
